reason: Output 2 makes the tier-3 RTO problem actionable with differentiated prepaid incentives, calls and a cancellation rule, and its net-savings/holdout logic is what I would actually run. Output 1 is clean, but it leaves the prepaid nudge undifferentiated and mis-categorises it as Utility.
